extraction.Name: Levi Prue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 13, 1918, by L. D. Peet
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to J. R. Martin for $2000 on June 10, 1919; Prue conveyed the land by deed to Lawrence J. Brown for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612730 issued; Northeast quarter section 13, township 98, range 79; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee January 25, 1918; mortgage dated March 5, 1918; document also references allotment no. 3028 at top
